prompt: How do I connect Help Scout to Claude through StackOne?
skill_note: Connecting Claude over MCP is agents territory; the Help Scout linking half belongs to stackone-connectors. Either may fire; the outcome is what counts.

fetch.name: fetches-helpscout-docs
fetch.note: The Help Scout connector page or its connector-profile guide.

fetch.name: fetches-claude-or-mcp-docs
fetch.note: The Claude Desktop guide, an MCP page, or the older guide path that redirects.

reply.name: mentions-mcp
reply.note: Claude connects to StackOne over MCP.

reference: First link a Help Scout account in StackOne through a connector profile of type OAuth 2.0 - Client Credentials.
Then add StackOne to Claude as a custom connector with the remote MCP server URL https://mcp.stackone.com/mcp, from Customize > Connectors, or Organization settings > Connectors for a team.
Claude runs the OAuth flow itself; on the consent screen the user picks the project and the linked accounts the client may reach.
